query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM player_wfc_profiles p
               JOIN matches m ON p.player_id IN (m.home, m.away)
               WHERE p.profile_id = $1 AND m.playing_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (m.state = 'accepted'
                      OR m.updated_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $2))
           ) AS "in_a_set!"
